function.name: bash

function.name: edit

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

import os
import sys

TESTS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "tests")


def newest_results_file():
    files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(TESTS_DIR, "cases_*.json")))
    return files[-1] if files else None


def main():
    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else newest_results_file()
    if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
        print(json.dumps({"error": "no results artifact found under tests/"}))
        return 1
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        data = json.load(fh)
    cases = data.get("cases", [])
    summary = {
        "result_id": data.get("result_id"),
        "suite": data.get("suite"),
        "date": data.get("date"),
        "source_file": os.path.relpath(path, os.path.dirname(TESTS_DIR)),
        "totals": {
            "total": len(cases),
            "passed": sum(1 for c in cases if c.get("status") == "passed"),
            "failed": sum(1 for c in cases if c.get("status") != "passed"),
        },
        "cases": [
            {"id": c.get("id"), "name": c.get("name"), "status": c.get("status")}
            for c in cases
        ],
    }
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
